info.name: Keycloak
info.description:
It separates KC from the rest of the FN APIs. It needs

``` bash
kubectl port-forward -n identities svc/keycloak 8081:8080

 ```

to run as keycloak API is not reachable via nginx. Port 8081 is set to not conflict with other possible KC instances running on the host machine. The env var `base_kc_url` will be the centralized variable to dictate where to find KC.
